नेमि

NEMI . The real name of daśaratha. (See under daśaratha).

नेमिचक्र

NEMICAKRA . A king, who once ruled hastināpura. Once, when hastināpura was washed away by floods of yamunā nemicakra built a new city in kauśāmbī. (bhāgavata, 9th skandha).

नेमिहंसपद

NEMIHAṀSAPADA . An important place in ancient india. The place is near Akṣaprapatanam in the Ānarta region. It was here that kṛṣṇa killed gopati and tālaketu.
